method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04/05; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Liability Act 2002 (Tas) (No. 54 of 2002), consolidated version published 2024-10-21 and current on Tasmanian Legislation Online at 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2002-054.txt (retrieved 2026-11-06); the s 27 formulas transcribed from the site's images civil1.gif and civil2.gif; no regulations: none is deposited, and the figures they or other instruments set (a prescribed discount rate, adult average weekly earnings, the Hobart CPI, the superannuation guarantee percentage) are inputs

seat: the individual bringing the claim: the injured person (or, for s 26, a dependant claiming under the Fatal Accidents Act 1934), the person with mental harm (Part 8), the guest (Part 10A), the person abused as a child (Part 10C, s 7AA); for Part 10B, the employee who is sued

checks.command: l4 run clatas-damages-cases.l4; l4 run clatas-liability-cases.l4; l4 run clatas-abuse-cases.l4; l4 run on each module
checks.result: clatas-damages-cases.l4: 134 of 134 satisfied; clatas-liability-cases.l4: 135 of 135; clatas-abuse-cases.l4: 57 of 57; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A negative control (three altered expected values in a copy of clatas-damages-cases.l4, one of them used by two assertions) gave four failures.

scope: Whole Act so far as a claimant meets it: ss 3, 3B, 4 (reach and start dates); Part 2 (s 5); Part 3 (s 6); Part 4 (ss 6B, 7, 7AA, 7AB); Part 5 (s 8); Part 5A (s 8B, s 4(2A)-(2B)); Part 6 (ss 11, 13, 15-17, 19-22); Part 7 (ss 25-28E); Part 8 (ss 29, 32-35); Part 8A (ss 35B, 35C); Part 8B (s 35F); Part 9 (ss 39-42); Part 9A (ss 43A, 43B, 43E); Part 10 (ss 45, 47, 48); Part 10A (s 49A); Part 10B (s 49B); Part 10C (ss 49C, 49F-49J, 49L-49P, 49R). Out: s 1, s 2, s 3A, s 3B(5)-(6), s 3C, s 4AA, s 12, s 13(3), s 14, s 23, s 28, s 31, s 37, s 38, s 43, ss 43C, 43D, 43F, 43G, s 46(2), s 49, s 49D, s 49E (as a gloss only), s 49K, s 49Q, s 49R(1), (3)-(5), s 49S, Part 11; see NOTES.md.
